summary: Working New South Wales situation catalogue with 745 guide/situation entries in 22 topic groups, 171 legislative reading entry points, institution contacts and 20 expressly sourced escalation pathways; separate encrypted private-case workspace and canonical operator-recorded Solicitors Advocate workflow. External guide texts are linked, not reproduced in full. This is not a certified exhaustive register of New South Wales law.
implemented: Public NSW catalogue available before case creation; grouped selector, search, source reading, institution contacts, sourced prerequisite/exception/timing routes, downloadable situation pack and prefilled private-case creation
Isolated cases; firsthand account intake; separate certainty/corroboration/dispute fields
Multi-attachment originals with SHA-256; corrections and redacted derivatives
Append-only hash-linked event records; review, qualification provenance, snapshots and separate analysis
Case source ingestion; labelled metadata-only public source entries
Operator-driven obligation mapping, exposure assessment and recipient-specific draft generation
Factual Strength band/basis recording without an invented numerical formula; legal-information coverage records
Structured summaries; selected readable ZIP with HTML/text, selected originals, JSON indexes and digest manifest
Encrypted device persistence and portable backup; original portable-work and protected-backup import adapters
GitHub private-store encryption, atomic save/readback, stale-write rejection and reviewed additive history merge
Required authenticated owner-hosted AI/research service code; payload preview/approval; cited drafts and source validation
Separate public Build page; public-application replication pack and exact-source manifests
Installable PWA manifest with supplied-logo-derived launcher icons, homepage Install app control, browser-specific fallback instructions and public-shell-only offline cache
AI configuration readiness checks, authenticated no-case connection probe and minimal server container deployment file
Protected selected-handoff export with recipient passphrase confirmation, exact source revision, local-only unlock page and readable ZIP recovery without a private workspace connection

Readable manual and AI installation guides from GitHub signup and coding-assistant connection, with up-front accounts/costs/permissions/privacy/recovery concerns and complete copy/download versions referenced by root AGENTS.md and included in the Build pack
Consistent navigation and current-page markers across all main pages; sequential guide links; public reading-position restoration for this tab

Psychological First Aid page with practical choices, 15 source-verified support options, expanded mental health situations and order-specific review routes; full terms in its explanations and shared navigation.
Installed application starts on Home; Open app points to Home, with the existing installation identity and workspace navigation retained.

Installed launch compatibility: older Workspace launch addresses return to Home before initialization. Returning to an installed app shows the public Home view while retaining the current workspace in memory; deliberate Workspace navigation resumes it. Native launch callbacks are supported where available, with a visibility-based fallback for Chrome on Android and a file-picker/modal exception.

Build guide, root replication instructions, manual and assisted setup, operating guide and complete pack consistently specify Home launch/return, retained Workspace resume, generated public Home content and launch verification.

Guided six-stage installation from Home or workspace, manual/assisted directions, concerns first, earliest unfinished Next action, existing storage/service/export forms, separate current-session verification and owner confirmations, and encrypted backup comparison without replacing open work.

Private repository continuity: explicit encrypted device remembering, unlock-only reconnection to the same repository and encryption identity, preserved offline work and remote revision, required installation checkpoint, usable Save privately connection/unlock action, and separate truthful device/repository save status.

Third build option: the owner first creates their GitHub template copy or fork, temporarily invites a trusted builder, completes the full required installation and independent handover, then removes temporary access. Includes complete public copy/download with shared requirements and full technical manual; independent operation and access removal are owner confirmations.
configurationRequired: Private GitHub storage needs the owner's initialised private repository, restricted token and encryption passphrase.
AI/web research needs a separately deployed HTTPS service with owner-controlled provider credentials and model.
NSW is the catalogue jurisdiction. Actual case facts and legal passages still need applicability and current-version checks.
